howToPlay: Utilize bushes and water to ambush enemies with Alli's unique movement abilities. Activate the Cold-Blooded gadget to enter an enraged state and combine it with the Super's invisibility to deliver massive damage based on enemy health. Use the Feed The Gators gadget to sustain yourself during combat.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on movement in bushes and water, DAMAGE to increase offensive pressure while low on health, and SHIELD to provide extra survivability during stealth approaches.
trait: This assassin is ideal for players who excel at stealth tactics and calculated timing to eliminate high-health targets.
